comment: Invented inputs. Bytes are hex. HKDF-SHA256 with salt "anmp", 32 bytes. Generated by VectorsTest (UPDATE_VECTORS=1).

inputs.nonces: f0f1f2f3f4f5f6f7f8f9fa + one byte: 01 circleSigned, 02 directRadio, 03 directInternet, 04 blob, 05 circle envelope, 06 inbox envelope, 07 alert.sender, 08 alert.owner, 09 alert.ingress

mailbox.comment: ADR 0084: mailbox recipient from the owner seed of inbox; packet = packets.directInternet content from deviceA, nonce 0a

chain.comment: deviceA (Handy) and deviceB (Tablet), mailbox = inbox.ownerPublicKey, n 0, seq 1

intro.comment: ADR 0116: card signed by the person key above; person = 16 x 0x22, to = 16 x 0x33, by = personId

radio.comment: ADR 0051: one channel anynear, hourly tags. ts = radioBudget time, device = deviceA, circle = circle.secret, patron key = pickup.patronPublic

chains.comment: ADR 0051 §5a: device radio secret, epoch of hour, epoch 4096 hours, window 720 hours

rule.comment: AnmpKind: radio = may go over radio (radio rule, ADR 0015, 0057), open = header only (ADR 0051)

hours.comment: accepted hours of ts (previous, current, next) with route and sender tags of deviceA

circlePacket.comment: public form: circle message of deviceA, signed, circle key, epoch 3, route = circleRouteTag, nonce 0a

directPacket.comment: public form: direct message deviceA → deviceB, unsigned, key direct.key, route = deviceBRouteTag, node 0x12345678, nonce 0b

alivePacket.comment: ADR 0083: sign of life of deviceA in the circle, public form, signed, circle key, nonce 10; labelBytes = longest ASCII label that still fits with this plan

aliveMissedPacket.comment: ADR 0121 §10: the plan of alivePacket in state missed (4) with the place of the phone in field 12 (50.1106 N, 8.6821 E, accuracy 12 m), public form, signed, circle key, nonce 12

aliveGuard.comment: ADR 0083 §5.7: the alarm a phone leaves at the relays with alivePacket, never sent over radio: the same plan and sender time, state missed (4), field 13 true, field 14 true (the phone raises the call itself), the place the phone knows in field 12, and in field 44 the call the alarm stands for (state 1, ID radio.aliveSos.id, place, battery 80, one place of the trail, start due + alarm, field 6 the plan). notBefore is ANDP-Not-Before of its entry, due + alarm

aliveWatch.comment: ADR 0121 §23: the start of a sign of life for one person, sent like a direct message, with field 15 the secret of the plan's own space. space is the circle space of that secret (Ed25519 public key); the guard is left there in the form of a circle packet with scope = the plan ID in b64u

aliveSos.comment: ADR 0083 §5.4: the ID of the call the plan of alivePacket turns into when the alarm of its due is due: SHA-256("anmp/v1/alive-sos" ‖ plan ‖ due as 8 bytes big-endian), first 8 bytes

carePacket.comment: ADR 0083: deviceB answers the plan of alivePacket with looking (1), public form, signed by deviceB, nonce 11

pickup.comment: ADR 0051 §5a: deviceA asks, deviceB is patron. ask with both short route tags; patron with one-time key, waiting 2; pickup up to hour with the windows of deviceA and the circle, nonce 0c. tags: all route tags a window gives, sha256 over them in hour order

border.comment: pickup windows of deviceA 10 hours after an epoch border: two windows

alert.comment: ADR 0062. sender: alert as the device address sends it (fields id, ts, prio, title, text, url, until, source, attachments = [blob.id, blob.key, jpg, garten.jpg, 10, 640, 480, hash 33…], key = alertKey garten-bewegung); owner: all clear by the owner (id d0…d7, ts + 60, prio 1, text Entwarnung, replaces = sender id, ended). Grants from ANDP IssueGrant, issued ts - 60.

joinLink.comment: ADR 0062 §11: link of an own channel with field 7 join = {0 device 11×16, 1 key 22×32, 2 inbox 44×32, 3 grant 55×40}

channelKey.comment: ADR 0062 §11: new read key for a subscriber; readKey = readPrivateKey, grant = readGrant, sig by the owner key

ingress.comment: HKDF over the 32 raw token bytes; record label Home Assistant

alertKey.comment: field 12: SHA-256("anmp/v1/alert-key" ‖ key in UTF-8), first 8 bytes

encoding.comment: text (4) always written, also empty; label (5) of a record omitted when empty; attachment type and size always written

stats.comment: ADR 0045. ts = radioBudget time, device key = inputs.deviceASignPrivate, person key = inputs.personPrivate
